name: visualstruct
description: Local visual compiler: renders a small VisualSpec to SVG, PNG, HTML, PDF, PPTX and DOCX files.
long_description:
VisualStruct renders diagrams and infographics on this computer from a compact semantic spec, and gives Claude only the resulting file paths instead of generated markup.

This extension is a launcher. It starts the VisualStruct v0.3.3 runtime that is already installed in your user profile (.local\visualstruct\v0.3.3). It does not bundle VisualStruct, needs no API key and sends nothing to a third-party service.

Requires Node.js 22+ on PATH, and D2 for the diagram types. With no output folder given, files are written to Documents\VisualStruct\output.

tools.name: visual_render
tools.description: Render a VisualSpec (YAML/JSON) to SVG/PNG/HTML/PDF/PPTX/DOCX files locally. Returns file paths and warnings only.
